introduction: WT-19 is a WOOKTOOL waterproof tape measure designed for B2B buyers who want a more distinctive retail product than a standard closed-shell model. Its stainless steel measuring tape, automatic retraction, and hollow case form a practical combination for hardware, promotional, and private-label programs.

Buyers can select metric, imperial, or dual-unit blade printing to suit their target market. The case can be matched to the desired appearance direction, while flexible-MOQ logo customization supports both new brand projects and repeat purchasing programs. Individual color-box packaging helps prepare the product for retail presentation and distribution handling.

For an accurate quotation, share the required length, measurement unit, logo artwork, preferred case option, packaging direction, target market, and estimated quantity. wooktools can confirm a suitable WT-19 configuration, sample direction, quality-control points, and export packing details before bulk production.
